notes: stage 3 pot-table of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, sitting servo-camera-9 (ten phone clips at 240 fps from above, pass-open, six crawl clips, reversal, steps, pass-close, 5 V). Angle of record the image reading of the horn tag against the reference tag (stage 0 camera-tag, 0.16 deg); frames to host time by a line through the 12 clapper flash midpoints per clip (t_before + 50 ms); pot rows at segments.csv t_start + tick / 20 kHz. pot_scale_counts_per_deg the mean of the table's line over the fitted range and over -155 to -37 deg, their sd as bounds; the table pos = T(tag) + one offset per moving segment, T a cubic B-spline at table_knot_deg knots chosen by two-fold cross-validation over chains, the rest points (last 100 ms of baselines and coasts, drive starts) at offset 0; the table is written to results/<pair>.table.csv on a 1 deg grid with its local slope. pot_scale_low_end/high_end and guard_span_deg from lines through the 11 drive starts within 150 counts of each guard (414 and 3460), se bounds; table_smooth_* the 10 deg knot table about its line on 2 deg bins over -155 to -37 deg, table_fine_* the 1.5 deg table less the smooth one there; their bounds and those of hysteresis_counts and pot_tag_speed_ratio are the reconciliation's spread between two blind analyses. table_fine_pass_share_*: the slope of each pass group's 1 deg bins on the slow bins, carry codes masked (+/-12 counts of each multiple of 256), mean of four with their range; _poly against a degree-5 table over the slow data (rest points, crawl holds under 35 deg/s, kicks at 0.1 weight past the ends) with the pot read at the frame's time less the chain's lead, the reading whose pass re-timing agrees with the leads in sign; _stamp_plus_lead the same with the pot read at the time plus the lead; _table on the table of record's smooth part with each segment's offset out; table_fine_pass_share the mean of _poly and _table with the range of both. table_fine_chain_corr the mean correlation between crawl chains of one direction and start about the degree-5 table. adc_*: codes weighted by speed over every driven row above 150 counts/s; missing runs never output with output on both sides, the 8-code rule's count beside them; wide codes over 2.5x the 61-code running median, adc_wide_code_deg the horn travel on one code from the tag, mean +/- sd over crossings; adc_carry_step_counts the degree-5 residual within 12 counts of each carry less 12 to 36 counts out, median and range. drift_open_close_counts close less open rest points, 2 sigma bounds; hysteresis_rest_split_counts the rest reading arriving - less arriving +, se bounds; direction_term_per_clip_counts the h of c = c0 + h dir + tau v per clip of 6+ segments, mean +/- se. stamp_lead_ms_range the per-clip tau of the same fit, median and range (positive = the segment stamps lead the motion); stamp_lead_open_ms, _ms_per_min and _rms_ms the line over the sitting of the per-chain lead from the correlation of 10 ms smoothed differences of tag and pot. crawl_*: holds from 200 ms in, tag line speed, mean +/- sd per duty, stalled = ended stopped (pot 20 ms slope under 1 deg/s for 40 ms); crawl_slowest_sustained the slowest hold still moving at its end to the slowest at 7 % or more that never stopped; speed_per_duty_pct the holds that never stopped at 7 to 11 % and every moving hold from 300 ms in as bounds. stick_slip by a restart of 0.3 deg after a 40 ms stop under 0.5 deg/s on the tag. ripple_*: Lomb-Scargle of the detrended tag over holds above 5 deg/s from 300 ms in, pooled against angle (x = v t); ripple_cycles_per_deg and ripple_hz_per_deg_s the pooled maximum, bounds the flat top's two bumps rounded outward to 0.01; amplitude sd x sqrt 2, mean over holds with the duty means as bounds. gear_ratio_commutation the commutation cycles per tag degree over holds of 100+ cycles, mean +/- se. lash_deg: value the commutation count in the horn's dwell, lo the count in the pot's dwell (2 counts of its turn), hi the re-acceleration model on the horn's dwell (extremum to 0.15 deg of departure), four reversals at 9 and 20 %; lash_bound_deg speed x dwell. reversal_dwell_ms the pot's dwell mean +/- sd, the horn's by the 2-count rule (lo) and the 0.15 deg rule (hi). pot_lag_ms no lag resolved, bounds the lead's rms about its line. pot_follows_counts the sd of pot less table within each hold. clock_rms_ms and clock_rate_ppm the midpoint fit's median or mean with the range of both the midpoint and the onset fits; tag_rest_sd_deg the detrended sd over the 21 baselines' second halves, median and range. One sitting, one servo with a free horn, a train in fresh Super Lube.
